program_name: Saskatchewan Research and Development Tax Credit
funder: Government of Saskatchewan — administered by CRA
amount_notes: CCPC rate: 10% refundable ITC on first $2M qualifying expenditures (2026-27 budget doubled limit from $1M to $2M effective March 18 2026). 10% non-refundable on excess. Combined refundable and non-refundable credits capped at $1M per year. Non-CCPC: 10% non-refundable only. Capital expenditures now eligible per 2026-27 budget.
organization_types_eligible: Corporations with permanent establishment in Saskatchewan
Corporations that are members of partnerships in Saskatchewan
Canadian-controlled private corporations (CCPCs) for refundable credit
eligibility_criteria: Must have permanent establishment in Saskatchewan
Must conduct SR&ED activities in Saskatchewan eligible under federal program
CCPCs eligible for refundable credit on first $2M qualifying expenditures
Must file federal SR&ED claim (T661) within 18 months of tax year end
Claim Saskatchewan credit via Schedule 403 with T2 corporate return
exclusions: CRITICAL: Non-profit organizations and registered charities NOT eligible
Corporations without permanent establishment in Saskatchewan not eligible
Same activity exclusions as federal SR&ED apply
Saskatchewan R&D credit is considered government assistance and reduces federal SR&ED pool
notes: 2026-27 BUDGET UPDATE (March 18 2026): Saskatchewan doubled the CCPC refundable expenditure limit from $1M to $2M. Most third-party guides still show the old $1M limit — use this verified record not third-party sources. Also new: capital expenditures (machinery, equipment, leasing costs) now eligible. Stacks directly with federal SR&ED — combined CCPC benefit: 35% federal + 10% provincial = 45% of eligible SK R&D costs. NOT applicable to Emerge Academy Foundation (NFP). Relevant for Emerge Academy Inc OpsCo and Sacral Solutions as for-profit entities if R&D activities exist.
